cjk.sql: SELECT ARRAY(SELECT r.tablename || '.' || r.attname AS col FROM unnest($1::text[], $2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(tablename, attname, position) JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = to_regclass(quote_ident(current_schema()) || '.' || r.tablename) WHERE t.reltuples >= 500 AND has_table_privilege(t.oid, 'SELECT') AND NOT row_security_active(t.oid) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_stats s WHERE s.schemaname = current_schema() AND s.tablename = r.tablename AND s.attname = r.attname) ORDER BY r.position) AS missing, (SELECT reltuples::float8 FROM pg_class WHERE oid = 'pages'::regclass) AS pages_rows, projection.* FROM (SELECT 1) AS one LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT pg_get_expr(e.stxexprs, e.stxrelid) AS expression, e.stxrelid = 'pages'::regclass AS correct_table, p.reltuples AS sampled_rows, has_table_privilege(p.oid, 'SELECT') AND pg_has_role(p.relowner, 'USAGE') AND NOT row_security_active(p.oid) AS can_inspect, x.null_frac IS NOT NULL AS collected FROM pg_class p JOIN pg_statistic_ext e ON e.stxnamespace = p.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_stats_ext_exprs x ON x.statistics_schemaname = (SELECT nspname FROM pg_namespace WHERE oid = e.stxnamespace) AND x.statistics_name = e.stxname AND x.expr = pg_get_expr(e.stxexprs, e.stxrelid) WHERE p.oid = 'pages'::regclass AND e.stxname = $3 LIMIT 1) AS projection ON true

WITH ranked AS ( SELECT p.slug, p.source_id, p.id AS page_id, cc.id AS chunk_id, 0 AS match_tier, ((((LENGTH(cc.chunk_text) - LENGTH(REPLACE(cc.chunk_text, $1, ''))) / NULLIF(LENGTH($2), 0)::real) + ((LENGTH(cc.chunk_text) - LENGTH(REPLACE(cc.chunk_text, $3, ''))) / NULLIF(LENGTH($4), 0)::real) + ((LENGTH(cc.chunk_text) - LENGTH(REPLACE(cc.chunk_text, $5, ''))) / NULLIF(LENGTH($6), 0)::real) + COALESCE(1.0 / NULLIF(POSITION($7 IN cc.chunk_text), 0)::real, 0.0)) * (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(p.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ->> 'provenance') = 'auto-extracted' AND (COALESCE(p.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ->> 'status') = 'unverified' THEN 1.0 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'media/articles/%' THEN 1.1 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'openclaw/chat/%' THEN 0.5 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'media/repos/%' THEN 1.1 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'originals/%' THEN 1.5 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'companies/%' THEN 1.2 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'concepts/%' THEN 1.3 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'meetings/%' THEN 1.1 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'extracts/%' THEN 0.3 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'writing/%' THEN 1.4 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'media/x/%' THEN 0.7 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'archive/%' THEN 0.5 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'actions/%' THEN 0.3 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'people/%' THEN 1.2 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'deals/%' THEN 1.2 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'civic/%' THEN 1 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'daily/%' THEN 0.8 WHEN p.slug LIKE 'yc/%' THEN 1 ELSE 1.0 END)) AS tf_rank FROM content_chunks cc JOIN pages p ON p.id = cc.page_id JOIN sources s ON s.id = p.source_id WHERE cc.chunk_text LIKE $8 ESCAPE '\' AND cc.chunk_text LIKE $9 ESCAPE '\' AND NOT (p.slug LIKE 'test/%' OR p.slug LIKE 'attachments/%' OR p.slug LIKE '.raw/%') AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND (((p.text_projection_revision = p.knowledge_revision) IS TRUE OR (p.text_projection_revision = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000153'::uuid) IS TRUE) AND (cc.body_generation IS NULL OR cc.body_generation <= p.body_generation)) AND NOT s.archived AND NOT (COALESCE(p.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'quarantine') AND NOT (COALESCE(p.frontmatter, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'pinned_question') AND cc.modality = 'text' ), best_per_page AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(source_id, 'default'), slug) * FROM ranked ORDER BY COALESCE(source_id, 'default'), slug, match_tier DESC, tf_rank DESC, page_id ASC, chunk_id ASC ), page_window AS ( SELECT page_id, chunk_id, match_tier, tf_rank, tf_rank AS score FROM best_per_page ORDER BY match_tier DESC, tf_rank DESC, page_id ASC, chunk_id ASC LIMIT $10 OFFSET $11 ) SELECT p.slug, p.id as page_id, p.title, p.type, p.source_id, p.effective_date, p.effective_date_source, CASE WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(p.frontmatter->>'message_id', '^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$', '', 'g'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN p.frontmatter->>'message_id' END AS message_id, p.frontmatter->>'thread_id' AS thread_id, CASE WHEN NULLIF(regexp_replace(p.frontmatter->>'message_id', '^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$', '', 'g'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN NULLIF(p.frontmatter->>'subject', '') END AS source_subject, cc.id as chunk_id, cc.chunk_index, cc.chunk_text, cc.chunk_source, w.score, CASE WHEN p.updated_at < ( SELECT MAX(te.created_at) FROM timeline_entries te WHERE te.page_id = p.id ) THEN true ELSE false END AS stale FROM page_window w JOIN content_chunks cc ON cc.id = w.chunk_id JOIN pages p ON p.id = w.page_id ORDER BY w.match_tier DESC, w.tf_rank DESC, w.page_id ASC, w.chunk_id ASC
